title: Yen Rally Continues, Canada To Retaliate Against US Tariffs | The Asia Trade 9/8/2026
description:
"Bloomberg: The Asia Trade" brings you everything you need to know to get ahead as the trading day begins in Asia. Bloomberg TV is live from Tokyo and Sydney with Paul Allen and Haidi Stroud-Watts, getting insight and analysis from newsmakers and industry leaders on the biggest stories shaping global markets.

Chapters:
00:00:00 - Bloomberg: The Asia Trade begins
00:01:39 - Yen surges past post-intervention high
00:09:07 - Iran says Hormuz deal with Oman just days away
00:13:52 - EXCLUSIVE: Sapporo Breweries Executive Deputy President Rieko Shofu on shifting production from Canada to the US
00:24:07 - BREAKING: Japan July labor cash earnings rise 4.7% Y/Y; est. +3.8%
00:25:33 - HSBC's Fred Neumann on global economic outlook
00:32:51 - Oil climbs on Hormuz risks, rising Chinese buying
00:38:04 - Bathla secures stopgap funds amid debt crisis 
00:42:16 - BREAKING: Japan 2Q GDP grows 1.4% on annualized basis; est. 1.8%
00:44:18 - EM stocks jump to highest since June as tech offsets higher oil
00:47:17 - Markets open in Japan, South Korea and Australia
00:50:25 - Growing BOJ hike bets drive yen's sharp reversal
00:53:14 - Partners Group's Anastasia Amoroso on investment strategy
01:06:05 - Huawei, Xiaomi unveil new foldable phones
01:12:10 - BREAKING: Australia Sept. Westpac consumer confidence falls 5.2% M/M
01:15:43 - EXCLUSIVE: Sapporo Breweries Executive Deputy President Rieko Shofu on North America business
01:19:14 - Canada to impose retaliatory tariffs on US goods
01:24:51 - AUSTRALIA AHEAD: Bathla's collapse leaves some homebuyers in limbo
01:31:51 - China looks west for its AI data centers
